title: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/2274 on the harmonised standards for high-risk AI systems
key_claim: The Commission decision of 12 October 2026, in force from 14 October, gives the first reference to a harmonised standard for high-risk AI systems under the AI Act.
frame_summary: The legal act that opens a presumption-of-conformity route for high-risk AI, starting with a single standard.

title: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 amending the AI Act (Digital Omnibus on AI)
key_claim: The Digital Omnibus on AI, adopted 8 July 2026 and in force from 27 July 2026, amends the AI Act and moves the application dates for high-risk obligations.
frame_summary: Simplifies AI Act implementation and gives providers more time before high-risk obligations bind.
notes: Structural anchor: canonical source for the postponed high-risk timetable. EUR-Lex rendered metadata only; the dates applied in the body (2 December 2027, 2 August 2028) are quoted from ActuIA.

title: EU AI Act: first harmonised standard covers only quality system
